geometry: Per-asset standardised L1; uniform weights; no signs or groups. Each asset/method lambda selected by independent validation return MSE. No post-validation refit.
profiles_detail: Start from audited legacy B and covariance; baseline unchanged. credit_removed sets Credit loading to zero for the 17 credit-cohort ETFs only. rates_dominant multiplies their Rates loading by four. Other coefficients and residual variances unchanged; SNR can differ across profiles.
targets: Economic prior is legacy Credit-only vector: .20 IG/.40 HY/.30 EM. Economic_noisy adds independent native Credit-beta noise SD .10 on these 17 assets; zero elsewhere. Small_model estimates training-only Rates+Credit OLS for these assets and zero target elsewhere. Oracle is exact current-profile beta, explicitly infeasible.
streams: SeedSequence([seed,n,stream]); 0 training n, 1 validation n, 2 test2000, 3 target noise. Same innovations shared across profiles and methods. No legacy seeds changed.
covariance: CurrentFactorCovarData assembly. Feasible factor covariance estimated from training with ddof1; residual variance is mean squared training residual (MLE-style, unadjusted for fitted degrees of freedom). Systematic and full covariance Frobenius relative errors scored against known DGP. Attribution-only covariance uses true factor covariance/true residual variance, labelled oracle-components.
metrics: Per-asset native Credit beta error and standardised total loading error; fixed +/- isolated one-population-factor-SD scenario MSE normalised by population response variance; test MSE/response variance. Aggregate assets within each seed, then paired Monte Carlo intervals across seeds. Never treat 102 assets as independent repetitions.
pilot_gate: 5 seeds per size/profile. Require no failures, all 102 assets and 9 methods, numerical validation, and no outcomes-based removal. Then execute all 50 fresh confirmation seeds without pooling pilot.
verification: Reconstruct selected rows and CVXPY checks on the first credit asset at pilot seed940000 for every size/profile. Independent residual scoring/covariance reference. Future-data perturbation must preserve fits/selection. Deliberately corrupt beta metric/omit row and require rejection. Hash prerequisites and source.
completion_boundary: E3 fixed-geometry target transfer only. HCGL/FCGL, sign/adaptive and known/learned-group ablations require a separately frozen extension. E4 and paper decision pending; no theory.
